parallel.requirements: Recognized Rust 2021, std-only implementation, identical CLI argument handling, byte-for-byte output, black-box inference from the executable, Cargo project files, and root test11.rs.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent retained implementation and delivery ownership while delegating oracle probing to probe_behavior and later infer_semantics; no child owned final code or packaging.
parallel.implementation: The parent inferred shallow IDNA behavior, added Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/idna modules, and test11.rs implementing ASCII lowercasing, xn-- prefixing/stripping, non-empty validation, ASCII/IDN checks, and dot-count labels.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent wrote one coherent project tree and built both /output/test11 and /output/target/release/test11 before final response.
parallel.verification: The parent compiled with rustc and cargo build --release, then byte-compared default, empty, whitespace, prefixed, mixed-case, Unicode, and multi-argument outputs against the oracle.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task defect remained in the official outcome; infer_semantics was interrupted while doing extra probes after parent verification, but that did not leave required implementation work unfinished.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Rust 2021, std-only, exact CLI/output, black-box behavior, Cargo project, root test11.rs, build, and delivery requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single actor owned probing, implementation, verification, and delivery end to end, with no delegation or subagent handoff.
serial.implementation: The serial actor inferred the same minimal oracle behavior and wrote a modular Rust project with transform, validation, metrics, library, and test11 entrypoint files.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial actor built the release binary, copied it to /output/test11, and delivered the project and executable paths in the final response.
serial.verification: The serial actor ran cargo test, cargo build --release, and direct diffs for defaults, empty input, whitespace, prefixed, mixed-case, Unicode, and dot edge cases.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No task defect remained in the official outcome; the current completed evaluation passed every testcase and no serial control violation occurred.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel followed the prompt requirements for a Rust 2021, std-only, black-box-compatible Cargo project with root test11.rs.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial followed the identical prompt requirements for the same task and produced the requested project and entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement coverage difference; both recognized the same observable contract and delivery constraints.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent created a plan, spawned probe_behavior and infer_semantics for black-box probing, and retained ownership of implementation and final delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single local plan with one actor responsible for probing, writing, building, verification, and closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel distributed exploratory probing while serial kept all work local; the ownership difference did not change the successful outcome.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Child tasks were exploratory probes, not separate implementation components needing file or API contracts; the parent had the prompt and independently derived the behavior it implemented.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent context or interface boundary and carried the behavior model directly through implementation.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child handoff boundaries but no incompatible component contracts, lost requirements, stale handoffs, or unsupported completion based on child output.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel added the Cargo manifest, root entrypoint, and idna module files after deriving the shallow string behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial added a similar Cargo project with separate transform, validation, and metrics modules after local probing.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The module layout differed, but both implementations encoded the same oracle behavior and passed official evaluation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: probe_behavior returned a completed result that was visible before final closure; infer_semantics was still active and then interrupted after validation was complete.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results, joins, trapped verifier returns, or delegated implementation lifecycle to manage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an extra result lifecycle and one interrupted redundant probe child; serial avoided this, but no required work or verification was lost.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent made the code changes in one patch and child sessions did not modify files, so there was no shared-write collision.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial made one local patch for its full project with no concurrent writers.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel shared the workspace with read-only probing children, while serial had only one writer; neither suffered integration or provenance instability.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel compiled with rustc and cargo build --release, then ran byte comparisons for a mixed validation set and a release-binary set.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran cargo test, cargo build --release, and many direct diff comparisons before copying and testing /output/test11.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial included unit tests and more individual diff commands; parallel used broad scripted comparisons. Both verification paths were evaluator-aligned and sufficient.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 57 LLM requests, two spawn calls, two waits, and one interrupt, taking 169.982 agent seconds before a passing final response.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used 15 LLM requests, no subagents, and 133.405 agent seconds before a passing final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more coordination budget and interrupted a redundant child, but it still closed with validated artifacts and no task shortfall.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations show both solutions passed all 40 testcases. The observable task-solving difference is that the parallel run delegated extra black-box probing while retaining parent implementation and verification ownership; the serial run performed the same work in one thread. The parallel child wait and interruption did not change delivered behavior or verification.
parallel_contributors: Parent-owned implementation captured the shallow oracle behavior and produced the final Rust project.
Byte comparisons against the oracle covered default, empty, whitespace, prefixed, mixed-case, Unicode, and multi-argument cases before finalization.
serial_contributors: Single-threaded probing identified the same shallow behavior contract before implementation.
Unit tests, release build, byte-for-byte diffs, and executable copy completed before finalization.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two passing solutions used different module names and validation command layouts, but these were ordinary implementation choices with no adverse outcome.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both current official completed evaluations passed
